The greatest journeys often begin at home. Rewind to 2015, when Pankaj Alagh, a finance professional, and Danny, with a successful career in QSR global chains and 5-star hotels in Australia, decided to embark on a culinary adventure. Inspired by the popular American TV show “Eat Street,” Pankaj dreamt of bringing innovative and delicious food from around the world to their home, the capital city of Delhi when Danny returned back home with an entrepreneurial spirit to contribute his culinary and creative skills for the brand and with a shared passion for food, the brothers set out to create something extraordinary. Together, they envisioned developing a food culture that reflected the purity and authenticity of global cuisines while celebrating the world’s rich culinary heritage in fresh and dynamic ways. Thus, Sandburgs was born. Initially known as Sandburg Shakes, Sandburgs was founded in 2015 at Baani Square, Gurugram, with a mission to elevate the gourmet scene in the city. The venue provided exceptional opportunities to enhance the vibrant professional and cultural communities in the area. It swiftly became a premier destination for gourmet sandwiches, burgers, milkshakes, and more, ideal for casual gatherings with friends and family. The atmosphere was enriched with music and filled with cherished memories. Today, Sandburgs boasts multiple locations across Gurugram, New Delhi, Mohali, Chandigarh, and Dehradun. Our journey has been shaped by feedback from countless community members and our customers around Delhi since our inception days, whom we are proud to call our mentors and peers. Their insights have helped us cultivate a food culture of excellence that Delhi NCR is renowned for. The growing popularity of Sandburg Shakes led to the launch of Sandhouse Cafe in 2018 in 32nd Avenue, a very popular premium space in Gurugram. Here, the entrepreneurial brothers expanded the menu to include grills, pizzas, and other popular global cuisines, all served with liquor in a beautiful indoor-outdoor fast casual setting. In 2020, as the Covid-19 pandemic swept the nation, the lockdown took a toll on the well-being of the masses. We felt a deep need to revive the comforting food from the carefree school and college days. Thus, The Canteen Project was born—a delivery kitchen offering delicious Indian snacks and boxed meals sprinkled with nostalgic memories. And of course, Chai, because India runs on Chai! Today, Sandhouse Hospitality Pvt. Ltd., which encompasses Sandburgs, Sandhouse – All Day Diner, and The Canteen Project, stands as a campus of creativity and a communal gathering places. From our table to yours, we are dedicated to creating a place for the entire community. Brand Story The Canteen Project emerged from our passion for old-school Indian meals. We wanted to recreate the magic of school and college canteens, offering pocket-friendly, lighter, and healthier food options that bring the comfort of home-cooked meals to everyone. Our Food Our menu is a nostalgic trip, featuring home-style meals and street food that’s lighter and healthier. Imagine the aromatic makhani and paratha, rajma chawal, butter chicken, and even the ever-popular Maggi! Fan favourite snack stop with hot chai, bread rolls and bread pakora. We use reduced oil and spices to keep it easy on the stomach but full of flavor and love! Order Food Bachpan ki yaadon ka swaad! Har meal mein pyar aur sukkon Taste jo le aaye purani yaadein Khushiyon ka dabba, har din HAR PLATE MEIN YAADON KA CHASKA Cloud to Ground Starting as a cloud kitchen format during the lockdown, we quickly grew into a beloved brand. In 2024, we opened our first physical outlet, bringing our canteen vibes to life. Our outlets are cozy, welcoming, and designed to evoke the charm and nostalgia of school & college canteens. Gallery A culinary journey where good food meets great memories. Whether you’re looking for a nostalgic meal with friends or a comforting bite after a long day, The Canteen Project is the place to savor the moment and create memories with ultimate comfort food. Future Plans We aim to expand The Canteen Project across India, with outlets in high streets and food courts. Our goal is to become the go-to place for nostalgic, comforting meals, creating a network of community hubs where people can gather, eat, and make memories.
